name: tyts
description: Tyts — and done. Translation, keyboard layouts, voice typing and English practice on one key, on your own computer, no cloud.

scripts.test:engine: uv run --project engine --frozen --no-sync pytest engine/tests -q -p no:cacheprovider
scripts.dist:mac: swiftc -O build/ocr.swift -o vendor/ocr-mac && swiftc -O build/kbd-mac.swift -o vendor/kbd-mac && swiftc -O build/clip-mac.swift -o vendor/clip-mac && swiftc -O build/mic-mac.swift -o vendor/mic-mac && swift build -c release --package-path build/speakers-mac && cp build/speakers-mac/.build/release/speakers-mac vendor/speakers-mac && node esbuild.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
